title: GUI-Rise: Structured Reasoning and History Summarization for GUI Navigation

layout.note: A left-to-right agent loop runs along the bottom (earlier summary and Observation t, the robot at Step t, an Action Output box, a computer icon, Observation t+1, the robot at Step t+1), and a very large cream thought bubble above it holds three stacked, numbered subtask boxes. The Instruction box sits at the bottom centre with long right-angled blue lines to both robots, and a line from the summary subtask runs down the right side to Step t+1.

lesson: Unroll the agent as the same character at step t and step t+1 with the environment between, and put the step's typed outputs in one oversized thought bubble as numbered, colour-coded boxes filled with real text, so the framework and a real trace read as one drawing.
